description:
Devices that are registered for the user. Read-only. Nullable. Supports $expand and returns up to 100 objects.

TIP: Lists devices registered to a user. Returns device objects with displayName, operatingSystem, operatingSystemVersion, isCompliant, isManaged, approximateLastSignInDateTime.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-user-devices
